text.tspan: paired chat, the quote or reply
text → ChatInbox: queues it; before the
first digest starts an empty conversation
5 send a plan with its buttons
replaces the conversation with the new digest
empty draft, then the text so far
every 0.7 s, kept alive every 20 s
draft: the answer as it is written (30 s preview)
Blue: Telegram Bot API. Green: OpenAI. Gray: queue, blob and table. Dashed: a read, a side effect or a preview.
